title: Structured exchange profile registry v2
description: Version 1 plus the project's appearance: colours for the kinds its documents use, applied wherever a kind is coloured and never written into a document. Profiles become optional, so a project may declare only its colours. Kept at .pi-outpost/structured-exchange.json in the project.

profiles.description: Profile files, by path relative to the project directory. Each must stay inside the project. May be empty or absent: a registry without profiles constrains no document.

rules.description: Rules files, by path relative to the project directory. Each names the registered profile it applies to, and is checked against that profile's vocabulary whenever it is read.

default.description: The identifier of a registered profile that documents naming no profile are held to. Declaring one also refuses documents that name an unregistered profile, and version 1 documents.

appearance.description: The project's colours for kinds, by vocabulary. A name in one map does not colour the other vocabulary; a kind not named keeps its automatic colour.

kinds.description: Kinds of elements, participants, table rows and timeline items.

relationshipKinds.description: Kinds of relationships and table relations.

kindAppearance.description: How one kind is drawn. Colour only; the renderer derives lighter fills from it.
